construction.note: Major: the cable leaves the top corner, loops around the body and ends in three strands for two earbuds, with no split point. The cable makes no sense.
Major: the frame does not add up. Crossed legs, seat rails and armrest posts meet where no real folding chair has joints, so it could neither stand nor fold.
Major: the deck reaches neither the shore nor the posts it should rest on, the rope around the post ends in the air, and the pier leads nowhere.
No errors. A real card: simplified, but every part attaches where it should and the slide could carry water.

perspective.note: Major: the body is tilted away from the viewer, yet every key is drawn front-on at the same size, in rows that do not follow the body's edges.
Major: the pole above the canopy and the pole below it are not one straight line, and the canopy is seen from below while the pole tip is seen from above.
No errors. A real card: the keys shrink and tilt with the calculator's face, and every edge agrees on one view.
